newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BOLOGNA EXTEND CONTRACT OF COACH ULIVIERI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOLOGNA EXTEND CONTRACT OF COACH ULIVIERI.

text.p: Newly-promoted Italian serie A soccer club Bologna on Monday extended the contract of coach Renzo Uliveiri by two years to June 30, 1999.
The club gave no financial figures for the deal.
Uliveiri, whose team are joint second in the league after five matches and only a point behind leaders Inter, has guided Bologna to promotion for the past two seasons.
